name: field-work-center-home-tasks-navigation
objective: توحيد Home/Tasks/navigation والتفاصيل canonical للميداني وإزالة تكرار History المثبت مع إبقاء كل عمل مقيدًا بأحدث authorization state.
truthOwner: DSH/Workforce own current work state; app-field owns presentation/navigation only.

tasks.objective: Converge all field work entry points to one authorized work center and canonical detail.
tasks.currentProblem: Home/History can duplicate draft truth while current queue types and deep-links have separate entry paths whose stale/revoked behavior needs exact-SHA proof.
tasks.requiredChange: Inventory all pages/tabs/cards/routes, merge duplicated presentation, expose Tasks as distinct work capability, and enforce server-authoritative current state at every entry point.
tasks.targetState: Home is the field work summary, Tasks is assigned work, no redundant History tab remains if it has no distinct contract, and every item opens one canonical detail with fail-closed authorization.
tasks.action: Trace controllers and navigation, remove proven duplicate History route/UI, wire filters/statuses to canonical lifecycle, and add negative tests for revoked/stale/deleted/deep-linked objects.
mustNotChange: لا إنشاء local work queue ثانية.
لا خلط verification visits مع onboarding assignments.
acceptanceCriteria: لا يوجد عرض مكرر غير مبرر لنفس drafts.
كل card يفتح canonical detail نفسها.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation convergence only if it breaks a proven distinct journey; preserve canonical state owner.
